      • setupPlayer

        void setupPlayer(org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
        Set up the player for the match. This handles teleporting, inventory setup, and any other necessary preparations. It is also used for respawning players during the match. If the player has the metadata "dead" set, when this method is called, the player will not be spawned as a valid player.
        Parameters:
        player - The player to set up for the match.
